# Data contracts

Each of the 15 typed contracts owns a set of facts, with one writer set, a known reader set, and byte-level pins over the frozen surface.

## Support levels

These levels describe serialized formats, not Python imports.

- **Public:** CLI `--json` rows, the web API, the `logs.jsonl` event envelope, and `.asm.toml` machine files.
  This covers [CLI listing rows](#cli-listing-rows), [CLI session status](#cli-session-status), [Live process rows](#live-process-rows), [Web payloads](#web-payloads), [Review read model](#review-read-model), [Review records](#review-records), [Event union](#event-union), [MachineSpec](#machinespec), and [Run/machine wire snapshot](#runmachine-wire-snapshot).
- **Durable but private:** state agent6 retains for resume, replay and diagnostics, not an integration API.
  This covers [Conversation](#conversation), [SessionManifest](#sessionmanifest) (`manifest.json`), [SessionSnapshot](#sessionsnapshot) (`loop_state.json` and checkpoints), the [ToolResult family](#toolresult-family) stored in conversations, [JournalEvent](#journalevent) in the machine's `journal.jsonl`, [TaskNode](#tasknode) and the task graph, git chain refs, and [provider transcripts](architecture.md#session-state-on-disk) (retained diagnostic history).
- **Disposable:** caches, live coordination files, and telemetry export cursors have no format-compatibility or migration guarantee.

Formats are not stable until 1.0.
From 1.0, changes will be backwards compatible, and deprecations will carry a warning for a period before removal.

## CLI listing rows

[`agent6.viewmodel.listing`](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/src/agent6/viewmodel/listing.py) &middot; mutable container + 2 frozen turn types

## Review records

[`agent6.review_records`](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/src/agent6/review_records.py) &middot; frozen dataclass

Define immutable review evidence and validate review boundary payloads.

**ReviewTarget** &mdash; Identify the immutable trees and path coverage of a review.

**ReviewLocation** &mdash; Name a repository-relative path on one side, with an optional inclusive line range.

**Finding** &mdash; Hold one review finding at a structured location.

**SeatReply** &mdash; Validate the verdict and findings returned by a review seat.

**ReviewVerdict** &mdash; Hold one indexed seat's verdict, including an explicit abstention on failure.

**LineOrigin** &mdash; Record byte-level evidence without dating a defect or changing its severity.

**FindingObservation** &mdash; Associate a finding with its panel and the seats that reported it.

**ReviewPanel** &mdash; Validate a completed panel's durable evidence, including its worker feedback.

**FindingResolution** &mdash; Record the operator's conclusion without inferring verification success.

**FindingAction** &mdash; Validate an operator request against a known review-state version.

Public fields: [Formats](formats.md#typed-records).

- **Written by:** app/review_actions, harness/{review_gate, review_history, review_panel, review_seat}, ui/cli/sessions_findings, ui/web/review_routes, vcs/review
- **Read by:** app/review_directive, harness/{loop_state, repo_context, run_chain}, ui/acp/review, ui/tui/{diff_pane, review}, vcs/review_rule_reader, viewmodel/review
- **Guarded by:** [test_review_action_execution.py](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/tests/unit/test_review_action_execution.py), [test_review_actions.py](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/tests/unit/test_review_actions.py), [test_review_loop.py](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/tests/unit/test_review_loop.py), [test_review_panel.py](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/tests/unit/test_review_panel.py), [test_review_records.py](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/tests/unit/test_review_records.py), [test_review_seat.py](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/tests/unit/test_review_seat.py), [test_findings.py](https://github.com/agent6-dev/agent6/blob/master/tests/web/test_findings.py) (19 test files exercise it)
